本地隐私存储：知识库、日志和 RAG 数据保存在用户指定目录，不依赖在线服务。
模块化结构：Skill、脚本、参考文档、浏览器页面和测试相互拆分，便于维护和二次迁移。

skills.description_zh:
截一张图，直接问你的Agent「点哪里、改哪一项、改完看什么」的 Aspen Plus 报错修复步骤。​
Aspen Plus 报错急诊室是一个面向 Aspen Plus 用户的 AI 诊断技能。把报错截图、Control Panel 文本或 .his / .rep 片段发给 AI，它会先逐字识别报错原文、出错模块与软件版本，再把问题归入输入不完整、物性与组分参数、收敛失败、文件与版本环境、警告判读、结果异常六类，最后给出一张固定格式的「诊断卡片」：这是什么错、为什么算不下去、在哪个表单改哪个字段、重跑后看哪个指标确认修好、还不行该走哪条分支、以及这一步最常见的错误做法。
它不要求用户先学会术语——信息不足时最多追问三项；也不押注某一个软件版本——V11 到 V15 的菜单差异会并列给出，版本只用于标注路径，从不用来拒绝诊断。所有数值与字段都要求有出处，不确定就标注「待核」并说明如何确认；每次只建议一条主改动加一条备选，并提醒先记下原值以便回退。
知识库完全内置、可离线使用：约 70 条中文报错速查、213 条带 Cause / Fix / Aspen 树路径的真实英文报错记录（MIT 许可开源项目，版权声明随包保留）、收敛与物性专题笔记、官方案例对照索引，以及基于 173 个真实 .bkp 文件实测出的 V11–V15 版本映射表。修复成功后，脱敏后的「报错关键词 → 有效改动」会沉淀到本地案例库，越用越准。
它只做诊断与输入指导：不代跑工程、不做从零建模，也不代替物料与能量平衡校核。
English：Send a screenshot. Get the exact field to change — and how to verify the fix.
Aspen Plus Error ER (aspen-error-er) is an AI skill that turns an Aspen Plus error screenshot into an actionable repair plan. Drop in a screenshot, a Control Panel excerpt, or a .his / .rep fragment, and the agent transcribes the exact error text, block IDs and version, triages the issue into one of six families — incomplete inputs, property/component data, convergence failures, file & version issues, warnings, and silent result anomalies — then returns a fixed seven-part diagnosis card: what the error is, why the calculation stalls, which form and field to change, which indicator to check after re-running, the single most likely next branch if it persists, and the common mistake to avoid.
No jargon is required from the user: if the screenshot is ambiguous, it asks at most three targeted questions. No version is left behind: menu differences across V11, V12, V13, V14 and V15 are shown side by side, and the version is used only to annotate navigation paths — never as a reason to refuse a diagnosis. Every value and field must be traceable; anything uncertain is flagged as "to verify" with a way to confirm it. Each reply proposes one primary change plus one fallback, and reminds the user to record the original value before editing.
The knowledge base is self-contained and works offline: ~70 Chinese quick-lookup entries, 213 real English error records with cause, fix and Aspen tree paths (from an MIT-licensed open-source project, with the license and attribution bundled), topical notes on convergence and physical properties, an index of official example cases, and a V11–V15 version map validated against 173 real .bkp files. Two dependency-free Python scripts provide offline keyword search and version detection. After a confirmed fix, a de-identified record is appended to a local case library, so the skill improves with use.
It diagnoses and guides input only: it does not build flowsheets from scratch, run engineering work on the user's behalf, or replace material and energy balance checks.
